title: Decision: Independent oracle test vectors for date/time conversion
description: message.rs lines 599-608, contact.rs lines 239-266, and chat.rs lines 264-281 all use known test vectors (e.g., unix timestamp 1_000_000_000 = 2001-09-09T01:46:40Z) verified against external sources (Python datetime, POSIX date command, RFC 3339 spec). This prevents self-referential tests where the code is its own oracle. Rejected alternative: comparing computed output to itself proves only that the code is consistent, not correct.
